title: 复古水彩豆沙花
raw_keywords: 复古水彩 手绘 豆沙色 墨线叶 花型
style_detail_en: loose expressive brushwork with visible watercolor washes
thin brown contour lines over the washes
muted earthy palette of cream, camel and mocha
hand-painted folk art feel, slightly imperfect edges

elements.name: 大花·盛开
elements.describe: one large loose watercolor peony bloom in cream and camel tones, open layered petals with a thin brown contour line, dense black ink speckled stamen center, hand-painted vintage watercolor

elements.name: 中花·豆沙
elements.describe: one medium brushy five-petal blossom painted in solid mocha brown watercolor with darker petal edges and a small dark center, loose brush strokes

elements.name: 小花·四瓣
elements.describe: one small four-petal wildflower in pale dusty mauve with a thin dark outline and tiny dark center dots

elements.name: 墨线叶
elements.describe: one black ink brush leaf sprig, five tapered leaves on a thin curved stem, solid black brush strokes with sharp tips

elements.name: 描边叶
elements.describe: one watercolor leaf sprig in warm tan with a thin dark outline, three simple pointed leaves on a slender stem

notes: 参考图：复古水彩+墨线叶，元素允许叠层（墨线叶/小花压在大花上），底色纯奶油色
